notes.title: Portabellows will be part of the Wholesome Games Celebration 🎉
notes.content: [p]So excited and thankful to be included in the [b]Wholesome Games Celebration[/b] in the "Upcoming" section ❤️!! Can't wait to see all the curated wholesome games next week ☺️[/p][p][/p][p]The event will be live at [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames[/url] on August 7th and lasts until the 14th![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43959626/f257c14f2ae743b12a8f29ce6c0095795927d798.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Latest Update[/h3][p]We're working hard on the game and Demo 😁[/p][p]Can't wait to share more![/p][p][/p][p][b]~ Nance and Phred[/b][/p]
